step1_analysis.circuit_type: Fully Differential Current-Mirror Operational Transconductance Amplifier (OTA)
step1_analysis.description: A fully differential OTA utilizing a PMOS input differential pair loaded by NMOS current mirrors, which drive the output nodes. PMOS active loads provide the bias current at the output, and a common-mode feedback (CMFB) voltage controls the output common-mode level.

paper_reference.title: A 5-mW Sigma–Delta Modulator With 84-dB Dynamic Range for GSM/EDGE

sky130_expected.calculation: Gm * Rout. Gm = 2*gm3 ≈ 0.38 mA/V. Rout = ro_nmos || ro_pmos ≈ 69 kOhm. Gain = 26 V/V = 28 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The extracted netlist lacks cascodes, so the intrinsic gain is limited by the channel length modulation (lambda) of the 0.5um devices. The paper's 80 dB likely implies a cascoded version of this topology.
Depends heavily on the load capacitance. With a standard 1pF test load, UGBW is around 60 MHz, which is sufficient for a 13 MHz switched-capacitor clock.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the non-dominant pole at the current mirror nodes (N6, N8).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Current mirror OTAs typically exhibit good phase margin if the mirror pole is kept at a high frequency relative to the UGBW.
The OTA consumes a fraction of the total 5mW modulator power. 400 uW is a reasonable budget for one amplifier in the loop filter.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, UGBW, phase margin, and power consumption of the fully differential OTA. An ideal CMFB circuit is used to stabilize the output common-mode. Transistor widths for the tail and NMOS mirrors are adjusted to 10u to balance the DC currents.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Fully Differential OTA
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Adjusted Parameters to balance DC currents (1:2 mirror ratio)
.param W_xm1=10u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=10u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=10u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 V_OM N8 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 V_OP N6 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N8 V_IM N7 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N8 N8 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N6 N6 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N6 V_IP N7 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 V_OP V_CM VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 V_OM V_CM VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N7 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 V_OM N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 V_OP N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}

* Biasing and Supplies
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VGND N4 0 0
VN1 N1 0 1.0
VN2 N2 0 1.0

* Ideal Common-Mode Feedback (CMFB)
B_CMFB V_CM 0 V='1.0 + 10*(0.5*(v(V_OP)+v(V_OM)) - 0.9)'

* Inputs (DC common-mode = 0.6V to keep tail PMOS in saturation)
V_INP V_IP 0 dc 0.6 ac 0.5 sin(0.6 0.01 10Meg)
V_INM V_IM 0 dc 0.6 ac -0.5 sin(0.6 -0.01 10Meg)

* Load Capacitance
CL1 V_OP 0 1p
CL2 V_OM 0 1p

* Differential Output Voltage Source for AC Measurement
E_diff V_DIFF 0 V_OP V_OM 1.0

* Analyses
.control
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  ac dec 100 1k 1G
  let gain_db = vdb(V_DIFF)
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(V_DIFF))
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k
  meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac phase_at_ugbw find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
  let phase_margin = 180 + phase_at_ugbw
  print phase_margin

  tran 1n 1u
  meas tran v_max max v(V_OP)
  meas tran v_min min v(V_OP)
  
  quit
.endc
